cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The escape-room attendant found our shortcut. Phase one is working. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me distract her so you could crawl through it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. She was supposed to feel she'd caught us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's throwing us out. We haven't solved a single clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the fast exit I planned. Ask her to put our time on the leaderboard; solving clues was only our cover.

mechanism: A directs dealing with an attendant, takes over the talking and frames discovery and expulsion as the planned route to a fast escape.
confusable: Unlike finding new hope after failure, A insists the exposed failures were designed from the start; authority takes B burden to preserve participation in that account.
comparison: Expulsion from a paid puzzle game differs from a parent taking control of a failed surprise party.
seedUse: D137-a discovered shortcut, distraction and fast exit; S02-a revises practical roles while claiming the plan already covers events.
